## Checklist / 自查清单

- [ ] The script loads in the host and works against a real server or a mock / 脚本能在宿主里加载，并在真实服务器或模拟服务上跑通
- [ ] New user-facing text is wrapped in `tr(zh, en)` / 新增的用户可见文本都用 `tr(中文, 英文)` 包起来
- [ ] `name` and the header `@name` are unchanged; the version is bumped in both the header and the export / 没有改 `name` 与头部 `@name`；头部与导出的版本号都已递增
- [ ] Emby and Jellyfin changes are applied to both files / Emby 与 Jellyfin 的改动已同时应用到两个文件
- [ ] README and README.zh-CN are updated where behavior changed / 行为有变化的地方已更新两份 README
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, ...) / 提交信息遵循 Conventional Commits
- [ ] No password, token, access key, private address or copyrighted music source is added / 没有加入密码、令牌、访问密钥、私有地址或受版权保护的音源
- [ ] I agree my contribution is licensed under AGPL-3.0-only / 我同意以 AGPL-3.0-only 授权我的贡献
